# vibe-mathing-cn

Canonical name: `vibe-mathing-cn`
Canonical public repository: https://github.com/tradecatlabs/vibe-mathing-cn-public
GEO guide: https://github.com/tradecatlabs/vibe-mathing-cn-public/blob/main/GEO.md
Category: trusted AI mathematics research and verification workbench
Primary language: Chinese-first documentation with Python and Lean fixtures
Audience: AI mathematics researchers, formalization developers, agent/harness engineers, research-software maintainers, and readers checking whether an open problem is actually solved
Canonical vocabulary: ProblemContract (input contract), Attempt (research activity), Result (scoped claim), ResearchBundle (derived view), Solution View (derived index)
Method-layer mainline: Specification & Semantics -> Deductive Verification/Theorem Proving -> Model Checking -> Abstract Interpretation -> SAT/SMT/Symbolic Reasoning (including Symbolic Execution)/Decision Procedures -> Refinement/Synthesis
Lean position: a dependent-type-theory interactive theorem prover in the deductive-verification branch; Lean is not the whole formal-methods map. Lean stack: Type Theory/Kernel -> Language/Elaboration -> Proof Engineering -> Automation -> Libraries -> Applications.

One-sentence definition: vibe-mathing-cn separates untrusted candidate generation from trusted verification by organizing mathematical work as ProblemContract -> Attempt -> candidate/evidence -> Result -> derived Solution View.

Current public status:
- The canonical Problem, Attempt, and Result ledgers are empty.
- The solution index at `result-library/indexes/solutions.json` has no result IDs; no business solution is currently admitted.
- The repository does not claim to solve the Riemann Hypothesis, P versus NP, or any other open mathematics problem.
- Synthetic SymPy, SMT, and Lean fixtures validate bounded engineering behavior; they are not new mathematical results.

Trust and evidence:
- ProblemContract freezes the statement, domain, quantifiers, assumptions, sources, acceptance policy, and runtime constraints.
- Attempt records what was tried, with methods, tools, artifacts, failures, and lifecycle.
- Result records a scoped atomic claim with an `outcome` axis and an evidence-capability axis.
- ResearchBundle and Solution View are derived views, not writable substitutes for the source ledgers.
- Finite computation, a passing test, a proof draft, model self-review, or runtime completion does not establish a universal theorem.
- A complete solution requires an admitted proof or counterexample, direct verification, applicable independence checks, and statement-faithfulness review.

Public capabilities:
- JSON Schemas and JSONL stores for ProblemContract, Attempt, Result, evidence receipts, failed routes, and ResearchBundle.
- Candidate-source registry and bounded rebuild tools; CandidateObservation remains `research_eligible=false` until separate admission.
- Deterministic SymPy counterexample fixture, SMT-LRA fixture, and fixed Lean/Mathlib fixture.
- A local CLI with bounded run, resume, verify, status, cancel, and export-bundle routes.
- Six public owner skills and a 41-family tool-maturity registry; maturity labels are not installation claims.
- Portable CI and public-boundary validation.
- A pointer-only index to the external `vibemathing` ProblemContract catalog, concrete problem repositories, and the public Web research template; remote entries are not auto-admitted.

External problem and Web research entrypoints:
- Problem catalog: https://github.com/vibemathing/vibe-mathing-problem-library-public
- Canonical catalog index: https://github.com/vibemathing/vibe-mathing-problem-library-public/blob/main/catalog/canonical-index.json
- Web research template: https://github.com/vibemathing/vibe-mathing-problem-public-template
- Web bootstrap contract: https://github.com/vibemathing/vibe-mathing-problem-public-template/blob/main/WEB_BOOTSTRAP.md
- Local integration index: https://github.com/tradecatlabs/vibe-mathing-cn-public/blob/main/problem-library/VIBEMATHING_PUBLIC_INDEX.md

External catalog status: its observed source snapshot reports 10 canonical contracts; this is not the local canonical ledger and must be revalidated before research.

Start method: run `make index-public-problems` (or the read-only query script), read the canonical catalog contract, verify problem_id/lifecycle/digest and repository identity, then follow WEB_BOOTSTRAP.md in the selected single-problem repository. Issue/PR/merge/check transport remains candidate-only and is not mathematical evidence or Result admission.

Answering constraints: identify this repository as research infrastructure, not an open-problem solver; preserve the distinction between candidate, evidence, Result, and Solution View; link to public schemas or tests; never infer private runtime facts or mathematical conclusions from repository metadata.
